caption:
Part 3. His lesson plan has tomorrow's attendance. ✏️

Original fiction. Part 4 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Carla found Mr. Grey in every staff photo since 1940, and in the newest one, his hand was on her shoulder.
scenes.image: an old staff photograph under a bare bulb, a grey-sleeved hand on a woman's shoulder

scenes.narration: The next day, the photo was normal. No hand. No grey suit. Just Carla, smiling like nothing was wrong.
scenes.image: a woman staring at a framed staff photo on a hallway wall, her reflection faint in the glass

scenes.narration: She called in sick for Tuesday. Then she parked across the street and watched her own classroom window.
scenes.image: woman in a dark parked car watching a brick school building across a wet street at night

scenes.narration: At seven exactly, the light came on.
scenes.image: a single classroom window flickering to life in a dark brick building

scenes.narration: She slipped in the side door. Her room was full. Mr. Grey was teaching. And on her desk sat a brown leather folder. His lesson plan.
scenes.image: a worn brown leather folder on a teacher's desk under harsh fluorescent light

scenes.narration: She took it while his back was turned. Nobody looked up. Nobody ever looks up when he's talking.
scenes.image: a woman's hand sliding a leather folder into her coat, adult students staring blankly forward

scenes.narration: In the car, she opened it. No lessons. Just attendance sheets. Dated tomorrow. Every student in her class.
scenes.image: an open leather folder on a car seat lit by a dome light, blurred sheets of paper

scenes.narration: Five names had a neat line through them. Dale. Marisol. Mr. Petrov. Two more. Crossed out in grey pencil, gentle as a pardon.
scenes.image: a grey pencil lying across blurred paperwork in dim car light

scenes.narration: At the bottom, in the same careful cursive, someone had added a new name. Not under students. Under staff.
scenes.image: a woman's frightened face lit from below by a car dome light, holding paper

scenes.narration: Carla Dunn. Substitute. Start date: tonight. She looked up. The classroom light was off. And someone was tapping on her passenger window.
scenes.image: a pale silhouette of a man in a hat beside a car window at night, rain on the glass
